description:
[measured] Historical rows as CSV, for backtests. dataset: liquidations | funding_settlements
    (since 2024-09) | funding_hourly | open_interest_hourly | hl_positions (Hyperliquid whale
    positions with liquidation prices). start/end are ISO dates (UTC). Without a key or on the free
    tier only the last 24 hours are available; Pro: any 31-day window; Bot: full history. The key
    is read from the MCP connection's X-API-Key header, or pass api_key. limit caps rows here
    (max 5000); for bulk use download_url with the same key.
name: get_history
